author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geçmiş zamanda (past simple); Türkçede de çoğunlukla -di geçmiş zaman kullanıldı, diyaloglar doğal konuşma dilinde.
"little sister / little brother" mesajlarda sevgi sözü: "kardeşim" diye çevrildi. Son mesajdaki "little brother" gerçek kardeşlik değil, Ines'in Mateo'ya sevgisi.
Kısa mesaj dili (wrong nr pls dont stop) bilerek bozuk yazıldı; kelime anlamlarında doğru biçimi verildi.

lines.en: Seven O'Clock
Every morning at seven, a stranger sent Mateo the sea.
lines.tr: Her sabah saat yedide bir yabancı Mateo'ya denizi gönderdi.

lines.en: It started on the first Monday of the summer.
lines.tr: Bu, yazın ilk pazartesi günü başladı.

lines.en: Mateo was in bed.
His phone made a small sound.
There was a photo from a number he didn't know.
lines.tr: Tanımadığı bir numaradan bir fotoğraf vardı.

lines.en: The water was green and blue, and the sky was pink.
lines.tr: Su yeşil ve maviydi, gökyüzü de pembeydi.

lines.en: Under the photo, there was a message.
"Good morning, little sister!
Look, the sea is quiet today."
Mateo read it twice.
He was fifteen, and he was a boy.
lines.tr: On beş yaşındaydı ve bir oğlandı.

lines.en: He had no sister.
So who was this person?
Mateo lived on a small island in the Atlantic.
lines.tr: Mateo, Atlantik'te küçük bir adada yaşıyordu.

lines.en: His house was yellow, with a blue balcony.
lines.tr: Evi sarıydı, mavi bir balkonu vardı.

lines.en: From the balcony, he could see the beach.
Usually, Mateo spent every summer in the water.
lines.tr: Mateo genellikle her yazı suda geçirirdi.

lines.en: But this summer was different.
Three days before, he fell off his bike.
Now his broken leg was in a heavy white cast.
lines.tr: Şimdi kırık bacağı ağır, beyaz bir alçının içindeydi.

lines.en: "Six weeks," the doctor said.
"No swimming, no football, no beach."
Six weeks!
That was the whole summer!
His friends were away, too.
Rui was with his grandparents, and Leo was at a camp.
lines.tr: Rui büyükanne ve büyükbabasının yanındaydı, Leo da bir kamptaydı.

lines.en: Mateo was alone in his room with his leg.
On the first day, Mateo watched TV.
On the third day, he looked at the wall.
"I'm so boring," he told his mum.
Mum laughed.
"No, you're bored.
Boring is different."
She sat on his bed.
"Show me that photo again.
The one from the stranger."
Mateo showed her.
He always told his mum about strange messages.
It was a family rule.
"It's our beach," said Mum.
"Look, there are the black rocks."
"Should I answer?" asked Mateo.
"Not yet," said Mum.
"Never send photos of yourself.
Never give our address.
And always show me first."
lines.tr: Ve her zaman önce bana göster."

lines.en: The photos came every morning at seven.
lines.tr: Fotoğraflar her sabah saat yedide geldi.

lines.en: On Tuesday, there was a white bird on the water.
lines.tr: Salı günü suyun üstünde beyaz bir kuş vardı.

lines.en: On Wednesday, there were small fishing boats.
lines.tr: Çarşamba günü küçük balıkçı tekneleri vardı.

lines.en: Every message started with the same words.
"Good morning, little sister!"
Mateo often thought about his first swimming lesson.
lines.tr: Mateo sık sık ilk yüzme dersini düşünürdü.

lines.en: He was six.
A tall woman with a red hat taught him.
lines.tr: Kırmızı şapkalı, uzun boylu bir kadın ona öğretmişti.

lines.en: She had a whistle and a kind laugh.
lines.tr: Bir düdüğü ve sıcak bir gülüşü vardı.

lines.en: "Head up, Mateo!" she shouted.
"Kick your legs!"
He was afraid of the waves, but she was never angry.
lines.tr: Dalgalardan korkuyordu, ama kadın hiç kızmazdı.

lines.en: On Friday, Mateo woke up at seven.
lines.tr: Cuma günü Mateo saat yedide uyandı.

lines.en: He looked at his phone.
Nothing.
At eight, there was still no photo.
At nine, there was nothing again.
lines.tr: Saat dokuzda yine hiçbir şey yoktu.

lines.en: Why did the photos stop?
Wrong Number
On Saturday morning, there was still no photo.
lines.tr: Cumartesi sabahı da hâlâ fotoğraf yoktu.

lines.en: Mateo went slowly to the kitchen.
"Mum, the photos stopped," he said.
"You miss them," said Mum with a small smile.
"Maybe," said Mateo.
"Can I write to the number now?
Just one message?"
"OK.
But we write it together.
And no names."
Mateo quickly typed, "wrong nr pls dont stop."
lines.tr: Mateo hızla yazdı: "ynlş nmr lütfn durma."

lines.en: Mum shook her head.
"This is a stranger, not Rui.
Write real sentences, please."
So Mateo wrote it again, slowly and carefully.
lines.tr: Mateo da mesajı yeniden, yavaşça ve dikkatle yazdı.

lines.en: "Hello.
I'm sorry, but this is the wrong number.
Please don't stop, because I love your photos."
He sent it.
Then he waited.
An hour later, the phone made a sound.
lines.tr: Bir saat sonra telefon bir ses çıkardı.

lines.en: "Oh no!
I'm so sorry!" the message said.
lines.tr: Çok özür dilerim!" diye yazıyordu mesajda.

lines.en: "My sister moved to another country in May.
lines.tr: "Kız kardeşim mayısta başka bir ülkeye taşındı.

lines.en: She got a new number.
So I sent my photos to you!"
Then another message came.
"Do you like the sea?"
Mateo looked at Mum.
"I love it," he wrote.
"But I broke my leg.
I can't go out this summer."
"Poor you!" came the answer.
"Then I'm going to send you the sea every morning.
lines.tr: "O zaman sana her sabah denizi göndereceğim.

lines.en: Is that OK?"
Mateo smiled for the first time in a week.
lines.tr: Mateo bir haftadır ilk kez gülümsedi.

lines.en: "Yes, please," he wrote.
So the photos started again.
Now there were words with them, too.
"Look, dolphins!
Three of them came very close today."
lines.tr: Üç tanesi bugün çok yakına geldi."

lines.en: "This red boat goes out at six.
lines.tr: "Bu kırmızı tekne saat altıda denize açılıyor.

lines.en: The old fisherman always waves."
lines.tr: Yaşlı balıkçı her zaman el sallıyor."

lines.en: "The water is colder today, so only two people swam."
lines.tr: "Su bugün daha soğuk, o yüzden sadece iki kişi yüzdü."

lines.en: Mateo read every message to Mum at breakfast.
lines.tr: Mateo her mesajı kahvaltıda annesine okudu.

lines.en: "How does this person know about the swimmers?" asked Mum.
lines.tr: "Bu kişi yüzücüleri nereden biliyor?" diye sordu annesi.

lines.en: "Maybe they live near the beach," said Mateo.
The stranger never asked for Mateo's name or address.
lines.tr: Yabancı hiç Mateo'nun adını ya da adresini sormadı.

lines.en: Mum liked that.
Mateo asked questions, too.
"Why do you get up so early?"
"Because I work at the beach," came the answer.
"My job is to watch the sea."
One morning, the photo was different.
On the left, there were houses on the hill.
"Good morning!" said the message.
"Today I can see a yellow house with a blue balcony.
lines.tr: "Bugün mavi balkonlu sarı bir ev görüyorum.

lines.en: It's the brightest house on the hill."

words.brightest: en parlak, en göze çarpan (bright → brightest)

lines.en: Mateo looked at the photo.
Then he looked out of his window.
The yellow house was his house.
The blue balcony was his balcony.
He went to the kitchen as quickly as he could.
"Mum!
The stranger can see our house!"
The Photos
Mum looked at the photo carefully.
Then she went out to the balcony.
"Come here," she said.
"Look at the beach.
What can you see?"
Mateo looked.
He saw the sand, the black rocks, the café and many people.
lines.tr: Kumu, siyah kayaları, kafeyi ve bir sürü insanı gördü.

lines.en: "Everyone on that beach can see our house," said Mum.
lines.tr: "O plajdaki herkes bizim evi görebilir," dedi annesi.

lines.en: "It's yellow, so it's very easy to see.
lines.tr: "Ev sarı, o yüzden görmesi çok kolay.

lines.en: This person doesn't know it's ours."
lines.tr: Bu kişi onun bizim evimiz olduğunu bilmiyor."

lines.en: Mateo felt better.
Mum was right.
"But now I want to know something," he said.
lines.tr: "Ama şimdi bir şey öğrenmek istiyorum," dedi.

lines.en: "Where does this person take the photos?"
Mum smiled.
"Then find the answer.
You have a lot of time."
Mateo looked at all the photos again, one by one.
lines.tr: Mateo bütün fotoğraflara tek tek yeniden baktı.

lines.en: They all showed the same beach, with the same black rocks.
lines.tr: Hepsi aynı plajı, aynı siyah kayalarla gösteriyordu.

lines.en: They were all from high up, too.
The swimmers looked very small.
"The person is somewhere high," he told Mum.
lines.tr: "Bu kişi yüksek bir yerde," dedi annesine.

lines.en: "Higher than the café, but lower than our hill."
"A tree?" asked Mum.
"There aren't any trees on the beach."
Mateo took his own photo from the balcony.
Then he compared it with the stranger's photos.
His photo was from the side.
The stranger's photos were from the middle of the beach.
lines.tr: Yabancının fotoğrafları ise plajın ortasından çekilmişti.

lines.en: He found other small things, too.
In one photo, there was a red float.
lines.tr: Bir fotoğrafta kırmızı bir şamandıra vardı.

lines.en: In another photo, there was a wooden step in the corner.
lines.tr: Başka bir fotoğrafta, köşede tahta bir basamak vardı.

lines.en: Then a new message came.
"A little boy was in the water today.
He was afraid of the waves.
I told him, 'Head up!
Kick your legs!'
He did very well."
Mateo read it again.
Head up.
Kick your legs.
He knew those words.
But from where?
It was the last week of the summer holiday.
The doctor was going to take off the cast on Friday.
On Thursday, the photo came at seven, as usual.
lines.tr: Perşembe günü fotoğraf her zamanki gibi saat yedide geldi.

lines.en: But this time, it wasn't the sea.
It was an empty red chair, high above the sand.
lines.tr: Yüksekte, kumun üstünde boş, kırmızı bir sandalyeydi.

lines.en: On the chair, there was an old red hat.
lines.tr: Sandalyenin üstünde eski, kırmızı bir şapka vardı.

lines.en: Under the photo, there was a short message.
lines.tr: Fotoğrafın altında kısa bir mesaj vardı.

lines.en: "Tomorrow is my last day here.
Thank you for watching the sea with me."
The cast was going to come off tomorrow.
And tomorrow, he was going to find the stranger.
lines.tr: Ve yarın, Mateo o yabancıyı bulacaktı.

lines.en: The Tower
On Friday morning, the doctor took off the cast.
Mateo's leg was thin and white.
It felt strange and weak.
"I'm coming with you to the beach," said Mum.
lines.tr: "Seninle plaja ben de geliyorum," dedi annesi.

lines.en: "That's the rule."
"I know," said Mateo.
But Mum had a strange smile on her face.
lines.tr: Ama annesinin yüzünde tuhaf bir gülümseme vardı.

lines.en: Did she know something?
They walked down the hill together.
The beach was full of people.
In the middle of the beach, there was a tall white tower.
lines.tr: Plajın ortasında uzun, beyaz bir kule vardı.

lines.en: At the top, there was a red chair.
A woman stood at the bottom of the tower.
She was tall, with grey hair under an old red hat.
lines.tr: Uzun boyluydu, eski kırmızı şapkasının altında gri saçları vardı.

lines.en: She had a whistle around her neck.
She looked at Mateo's leg.
Then she looked at his face.
"Head up, Mateo," she said with a big smile.
Mateo stopped.
He knew that voice.
He knew that laugh.
"Ines?" he said.
"You taught me to swim!"
"Yes, I did," said Ines.
"You were a very brave little boy.
You were afraid, but you never stopped."
"The photos were from your tower!" said Mateo.
"It was you!"
"And it was you!" laughed Ines.
"I didn't know until today."
Mum laughed, too.
"I guessed last week.
I heard 'Head up!
Kick your legs!' all summer, nine years ago."
lines.tr: Bacaklarını çırp!' sözlerini dokuz yıl önce bütün yaz duymuştum."

lines.en: They sat on the sand next to the tower.
Ines told them her story.
For thirty years, she watched the sea from this tower.
lines.tr: Otuz yıl boyunca bu kuleden denizi izlemişti.

lines.en: Every morning, she took a photo for her little sister.
lines.tr: Her sabah küçük kız kardeşi için bir fotoğraf çekerdi.

lines.en: But in May, her sister moved to a cold country far away.
lines.tr: Ama mayısta kız kardeşi uzak, soğuk bir ülkeye taşındı.

lines.en: "She missed the sea," said Ines.
"So I sent it to her.
Then I sent it to the wrong number.
But my best swimmer saw it."
"Is today really your last day?" asked Mateo.
lines.tr: "Bugün gerçekten son günün mü?" diye sordu Mateo.

lines.en: "Yes.
A new lifeguard starts tomorrow."
She looked at him.
"But next summer, we're going to train young volunteers.
They help the lifeguards.
Do you want to try?"
Mateo looked at the sea.
It was green and blue, and very quiet.
lines.tr: Deniz yeşil ve maviydi, çok da sakindi.

lines.en: "Yes," he said.
"Yes, please."
The next morning at seven, his phone made a small sound.
lines.tr: Ertesi sabah saat yedide telefonu küçük bir ses çıkardı.

lines.en: There was a photo of the sea and a message.
lines.tr: Bir deniz fotoğrafı ve bir mesaj vardı.

lines.en: "Good morning, little brother!
Head up.
See you next summer."

phrases.note: I'm boring = Ben sıkıcıyım. Mateo karıştırıyor; annesi düzeltiyor.
"I'm going to send you the sea every morning." = "Sana her sabah denizi göndereceğim."
Nedeni söyler: "Because I work at the beach."
Sonucu söyler: "It's yellow, so it's very easy to see."
Yüzme dersinde: başını sudan yukarıda tut. Mesajda: "Moralini yüksek tut" anlamı da var.
